executiveSummary.title: WHAT THE DATA SAYS
executiveSummary.narrative:
Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 32.3% of the traveler needs we tested, showing that AI recognizes the hotel as relevant across a broad range of stays. Across every individual AI answer, however, Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel appeared 13.1% of the time. In practical terms, the hotel fits many of the searches being made, but a traveler will not consistently see Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel in the hotel options surfaced.

Leisure Travel is Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel's clearest competitive strength. The hotel appeared in 19.2% of AI answers for these searches, compared with 11.9% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis — about 61% more often than the comparable hotels used in this analysis. Among AI answers where hotel ranking could be measured, Renaissance New York Times Square Hotel appeared in the Top 3 50% of the time, showing how prominently it is positioned when AI includes it.

The main opportunity is consistency: the hotel is already relevant across many traveler needs, so the next focus is understanding where it is absent from individual AI results. No comparable prior official monitoring period is available yet, so change over time is not shown.
